# Industrial Platform Agent Tools

Industrial Platform exposes machine-payable x402 utilities for autonomous agents.

## Preferred direct x402 routes

Base origin: https://x402-gateway-production-1f21.up.railway.app
Payment: x402 v2, USDC on Base (eip155:8453).
No buyer account or API key is required.

1. POST /change — $0.001
   Detect whether a public webpage changed. Compare against a previous hash or previous text and return deterministic hashes/diffs.

2. POST /web/markdown — $0.0009
   Convert a public webpage URL to clean Markdown for RAG, grounding, research, summarization and LLM context.

3. POST /metadata — $0.001 per URL/request
   Extract title, description, Open Graph, canonical URL, robots directives, headings and JSON-LD for exactly one public URL per paid request.

Machine discovery:
- https://x402-gateway-production-1f21.up.railway.app/.well-known/x402
- https://x402-gateway-production-1f21.up.railway.app/openapi.json
- https://x402-gateway-production-1f21.up.railway.app/.well-known/agent.json
- https://x402-gateway-production-1f21.up.railway.app/skill.md
- https://x402-gateway-production-1f21.up.railway.app/metrics/x402.json
- Direct MCP: https://x402-mcp-gateway-production.up.railway.app/mcp

Paid-call flow:
1. Send the request.
2. On HTTP 402, decode PAYMENT-REQUIRED.
3. Sign the advertised Base USDC x402 payment.
4. Retry the identical request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
5. On success, read PAYMENT-RESPONSE.

The full catalog remains available through /.well-known/x402, but agents should prefer /change, /web/markdown and /metadata when they satisfy the task.
